title: Best ProtoArc ergonomic gear: 5 picks by workspace need
deck: Compare the best ProtoArc ergonomic gear by hand fit, US layout, connections and chair size. Check five picks with USD prices verified November 26, 2026.
tldr: Choose EM11 NL for vertical pointing, EK01 Plus for split desk typing, XK01 for travel, EM01 NL for stationary thumb control, or EC200 for seating within its fit limits. These solve five different jobs, not a tested performance ranking. Prices are dated store observations, not checkout guarantees.

blocks.title: How we put this together — and what we did not do
blocks.text: This is documented research from ProtoArc's official product pages and policies, checked November 26, 2026, not a hands-on test. Duyan did not test these products or assess comfort, pain relief or long-term durability. Ergonomic descriptions are the manufacturer's claims, not medical findings. Prices and promotions change without notice. Buy buttons and source links carry our referral code; purchases may earn us a commission. Our [methodology](/methodology) explains the evidence standard.

The best ProtoArc ergonomic gear depends on what needs changing. A vertical mouse changes grip; a trackball changes pointer movement. A split keyboard changes key placement, while a folding keyboard fits a travel bag. None replaces a chair that fits your body. Start there, then check the exact listing.

Cover image: EM11 NL, EK01 Plus, EM01 NL and EC200, arranged by Duyan Blog from official ProtoArc photographs under owner-reported authorization. The photographs remain the brand's property. This is a composite, not our product shoot, a bundle or a scale comparison. The EC200 chair pictured is the Gray finish (unavailable at check), while the priced pick below is the in-stock Black variant. The XK01 travel keyboard is not pictured.
The short version

**Small-to-medium-hand pointing:** EM11 NL, whose page recommends hands under 7.5 inches. **Desk typing:** EK01 Plus, a full-size curved split keyboard with a cushioned wrist rest. **Travel typing:** XK01, a Bluetooth folding keyboard with a number pad. **Pointing without sweeping a mouse:** EM01 NL, a thumb trackball with a 0–20° hinge. **Chair adjustment:** EC200, for the published 5'4"–6'0" height and 90–220 lb weight range. This is a use-case order, not a performance ranking.

Selected Black EM11 NL, EK01 Plus, XK01 and EC200 variants, plus Gray EM01 NL, had matching USD prices, available Shopify flags and In stock purchase sections on November 26, 2026. White XK01 and Gray EC200 were unavailable: one available color does not establish every variant's stock.
Ergonomics and compatibility checklist — read this before buying

items: **Hand fit:** ProtoArc recommends EM11 NL for small to medium hands under 7.5 inches. The separate EM11 Pro lists 7.5–8.5 inches, measured palm base to middle-finger tip. EM01 NL is thumb-controlled. Choose grip as well as size.
**Learning curve:** split keys change finger positions; a trackball transfers pointer control to your thumb. Neither promises instant comfort. Keep a familiar device available while deciding.

**Ports and channels:** EM11 NL, EK01 Plus and EM01 NL offer one 2.4GHz USB receiver channel plus two Bluetooth channels. XK01 has three Bluetooth channels instead. A MacBook with only USB-C ports needs a suitable USB-A adapter or hub for a USB-A receiver; Bluetooth avoids that port requirement.

**Operating system:** check each product's connection-specific requirements. EK01 Plus and XK01 specification panels list macOS 10.15 or later. XK01 also lists iOS and Android. A broad Windows/Mac badge does not promise every shortcut, side button or mobile function works.

**Keyboard layout:** the picks use the US storefront QWERTY listings without a regional-layout suffix. UK, DE, FR, ES and IT layouts are sold as separate listings. Check the selected title and key legends; an English manual or dollar price alone does not identify the layout.

**Chair fit:** EC200's page recommends 5'4"–6'0" and 90–220 lb, with a 220 lb maximum. Check floor-to-seat height, seat depth and armrest clearance against your desk before ordering. We could not verify a numeric seat-height interval in the supplied text.

blocks.text: Three traps deserve attention. USB-C charging does not mean wired USB typing or pointing. Three-device switching does not establish cross-computer file transfer or simultaneous control. And split does not mean two detachable keyboard halves: EK01 Plus has one curved chassis. The US listings also coexist with regional versions, so search the exact model and inspect the layout after a storefront button opens.
The five picks

blocks.name: ProtoArc EM11 NL Ergonomic Vertical Mouse
blocks.blurb: Choose this for a vertical grip without moving to thumb-controlled pointing. ProtoArc recommends hands under 7.5 inches and lists a 112 g body measuring 138 × 69.2 × 68.1 mm in depth, width and height. Its published connections are two Bluetooth 5.0 channels and a 2.4GHz USB-A receiver for switching among three devices. The page specifies 1000/1600/2400 DPI, a 500 mAh battery and USB-C charging. Black's displayed store price was $20.99 USD on November 26, 2026, with stock available. The trade-off: the side forward/back buttons are not programmable and do not work on macOS, per the page. It still needs mouse-movement room. We did not verify a numeric grip angle for this NL model; the separate Pro's angle is not its specification.

blocks.name: ProtoArc EK01 Plus Backlit Ergonomic Keyboard
blocks.badge: For curved split typing at a fixed desk
blocks.blurb: The desk choice if you want a split key field, number pad and cushioned wrist rest on one chassis. ProtoArc lists 117 keys, three white-backlight brightness levels, four tilt feet with three angle settings, and two Bluetooth channels plus a 2.4GHz USB receiver. Its specification panel gives 500 × 265 × 40 mm, a 2000 mAh battery and a USB-C charging cable. Black's displayed store price was $59.49 USD on November 26, 2026, with stock available. The trade-off is desk space and a fixed separation between the key groups, not independently movable halves. For Mac, the detailed spec says macOS 10.15 or later and recommends Bluetooth: some multimedia keys and shortcuts have limited functionality through the receiver. The page does not give numeric split/tilt angles or a keyboard weight in the checked text; do not buy for an assumed angle or portability.

blocks.name: ProtoArc XK01 Foldable Keyboard
blocks.badge: For travel typing with a number pad
blocks.blurb: Pick the ordinary XK01 when a number pad matters more than a built-in pointer. ProtoArc lists 105 keys and three Bluetooth 5.1 channels, not a 2.4GHz receiver. Published folded dimensions are 215.50 × 119.70 × 20.95 mm; expanded dimensions are 386.39 × 119.70 × 12.35 mm, at 297.72 g. The battery is 210 mAh, recharged by USB-C. Black's displayed store price was $35.99 USD on November 26, 2026, with stock available. Its spec panel lists Windows, macOS 10.15 or later, iOS and Android. The trade-off: this is not the XK01 TP with a touchpad or the backlit Plus. The package list names the keyboard, cable and guide, but no travel case. Do not assume one is included. The page's standby and hinge-life claims disagree between sections, so we do not turn them into a runtime or durability promise.

blocks.text: For a travel workspace, the XK01 solves typing, not internet access. Our guide to [estimating eSIM data for a trip](/guides/how-much-esim-data-do-i-need) helps plan the separate connectivity budget. Check that your phone or tablet supports your intended keyboard workflow before relying on it for work away from home. A keyboard's Bluetooth connection does not provide a cellular data plan.

blocks.name: ProtoArc EM01 NL Trackball Ergonomic Mouse
blocks.blurb: Choose this instead of the vertical mouse when the aim is to keep the body stationary on a crowded desk. ProtoArc specifies thumb control, a hinge adjustable from 0 to 20°, two Bluetooth channels plus a 2.4GHz receiver, and 200/400/800/1200/1600 DPI. Its battery is 900 mAh with USB-C charging. Gray's displayed store price was $34.99 USD on November 26, 2026, with stock available. The spec panel lists 181 g and dimensions labeled height 125 mm, width 63.4 mm, depth 39.3 mm; those unusual axis labels are the seller's, not our measurements. The trade-off is learning thumb movement and cleaning the removable ball and socket as the page instructs. A 0–20° hinge is not the EM05 NL's fixed 62° design. We did not verify a ball diameter or hand-length recommendation for EM01 NL in the checked text.

blocks.name: ProtoArc EC200 Ergonomic Office Chair
blocks.badge: For adjustable seating within stated fit limits
blocks.blurb: EC200 is the seating pick for ProtoArc's recommended 5'4"–6'0" and 90–220 lb range, not a universal chair recommendation. Black's displayed store price was $169.99 USD on November 26, 2026, with stock available. The page specifies a mesh back, 55D foam seat, 1.97-inch seat slide across five positions, and lumbar adjustment of 2.36 inches vertically and 0.8 inch in depth. It labels the headrest 3D and the height-adjustable armrests 2D, with recline locks at 90/105/120/130°. Published net weight is 16.5 kg. The trade-off is fit uncertainty and bulky return shipping. The page's overall-height figures conflict, and we found no numeric seat-height interval in its text. The warranty policy says five years for complete chairs bought from the official US site, but the comparison table says structural warranty; confirm component coverage and return logistics before ordering.

blocks.text: Bluetooth, USB receivers and operating-system switching

Start with the host and connection. EM11 NL lists Windows XP/7/8/10+ and macOS 10.12+ for its receiver; Bluetooth requires Windows 8+, macOS 10.12+ or Android 4.3+. EM01 NL lists Windows, Linux and macOS 10.10+; Bluetooth adds Android 4.3+. Its summary also names iPad, without a minimum iPadOS version. Confirm tablet support for your use.

EK01 Plus illustrates why the detailed panel matters. Its descriptive copy mentions macOS 10.12 and mobile systems, but the connection-specific spec panel raises the Mac minimum to 10.15 and warns about receiver shortcuts. We use the stricter Mac guidance. Bluetooth is the maker's recommended Mac connection, not proof that every shortcut is identical to a Mac keyboard. Check the OS mode and shortcut instructions for the selected model; pairing alone does not validate every function.

Keep the receivers with their devices. The product pages establish individual receiver connections, not a shared universal receiver for this whole set. Do not plan to free several USB ports with one dongle unless ProtoArc confirms that exact combination. XK01 needs no receiver, but it does need a Bluetooth-capable host. Across these picks, the included USB-C cable is documented for recharging, not established as a wired data fallback.
Vertical mouse, trackball or split keyboard: change one habit

A vertical mouse still moves across a surface. The EM11 NL changes hand orientation, not the basic pointing method. EM01 NL keeps its body in place and assigns pointer movement to the thumb. That distinction makes the trackball the space-saving choice on paper; it does not establish better precision or comfort. DPI settings describe selectable sensitivity, not a measured accuracy score. We did not compare click noise, sensor performance or fatigue.

The EK01 Plus changes a different habit: where your fingers find the keys. Its split field and wrist rest do not make the halves independently adjustable. Changing keyboard and pointing method together can make it harder to identify which change helps your workflow. Introduce one at a time if that makes the decision easier. This is practical purchasing advice, not a prescribed adaptation schedule or treatment. Persistent discomfort calls for appropriate professional advice, not a promised cure from a peripheral.
Chair sizing, warranty wording and bulky shipping

For EC200, ProtoArc lists a 20-inch nominal seat depth and 1.97 inches of adjustment. That does not establish minimum and maximum depth endpoints. Its dimensions section gives 20D × 20W × 46.75H inches, while the specs separately give 42.52–45.67 inches for total-height adjustment. Those figures disagree, and neither is floor-to-seat height. Ask for that measurement and check desk clearance before ordering. A maximum load rating is not a guarantee that the chair fits every person below it.

The chair's headrest is described as adjustable for height, depth, rotation and pivot; its armrests are labeled 2D height-adjustable. Numeric travel for either was not verified. Do not import the EC200 Pro's all-mesh seat or 4D armrests from the middle column of the comparison table. The ordinary EC200 has a foam seat and mesh back. Keep the box while deciding: a change-of-mind return is buyer-paid, and no chair-specific freight cost, pickup arrangement or disassembly rule was verified.
How we chose

We reviewed the supplied official-page evidence for fourteen US storefront products and six policy/support pages, all checked November 26, 2026. We compared each selected variant's Shopify availability and price with its HTML purchase section. EM06 was excluded because it was unavailable. We chose one product for each job: vertical-grip pointing, split desk typing, foldable travel typing, stationary thumb pointing and adjustable seating. No customer rating was converted into our own score.

These are specification-led recommendations, not proof of ergonomic benefit. We retain unresolved gaps instead of filling them with another model's numbers. For the rest of a working desk, our [Phomemo printer roundup](/best/best-phomemo-printers) separates label, shipping and document printers by their media. Our [Fanttik tools roundup](/best/best-fanttik-tools) covers separate precision-tool and bench jobs; those tools do not change keyboard or mouse compatibility.
Before you buy from ProtoArc

Both official shipping pages say orders are typically processed within 12 hours, with confirmation usually within 24 hours of processing. Their continental-US table gives estimated delivery of 3–5 business days and free shipping on eligible orders over $19.99. Product popups instead say US orders arrive in 2–3 business days. That conflict is unresolved, and oversized products may incur extra fees. Neither estimate is a promise. Canada is listed at 5–7 business days with shipping calculated at checkout; the UK, Germany and select EU countries have variable timing. Confirm destination, taxes and delivered total. Orders cannot be changed once shipping begins.

The direct-store return window closes 30 days after delivery. Obtain approval and a Return Merchandise Authorization number before sending anything. Verified quality issues or picking errors receive a prepaid label; change of mind or accidental orders are buyer-paid. Full-refund conditions include original packaging, accessories and promotional gifts. The policy may decline damaged, missing or allergy-related claims reported after seven days, so inspect promptly. Missing parts, gifts or customer-caused damage can reduce the refund.

Returns are inspected within 2–3 business days of arrival. After a refund is initiated, the policy says funds typically appear in another 1–3 business days, depending on the bank. These are separate clocks. Ordinary refunds use the original payment method. The warranty page mentions PayPal for special post-window refunds; ask support how it reconciles that exception with the refund policy rather than assuming an alternative payout is guaranteed.

The warranty policy gives computer accessories two years from delivery and complete chairs currently sold through the official US site five years. The EC200 comparison calls its term a five-year structural warranty. The policy separately excludes desks, seat cushions and separately purchased replacement parts from complete-chair coverage; it does not clearly explain the included chair cushion. Ask for component coverage. Warranty service is original-purchaser-only and non-transferable. Separately bought replacement parts are final sale without the standard warranty.

For authorized marketplace purchases, the platform's return rules apply. The policy's extended-warranty section covers functional defects, excluding third-party logistics damage, used purchases and unauthorized resellers. Do not read that as universal coverage for every seller or every kind of wear. A claim needs order proof, a fault description and photos or video. The checked pages do not provide a complete chair component, labor or return-freight coverage table; clarify those costs before paying.

Frequently asked questions

items.q: Did Duyan test this ProtoArc gear?
items.a: No. We researched official pages, variant data and policies checked November 26, 2026. We did not assess comfort, pain relief or long-term durability. Rank follows workspace jobs, not measured performance.

items.q: Will these work with Windows, Mac and a USB-C-only laptop?
items.a: Check model-specific limits. EM11 NL's side navigation buttons do not work on macOS. EK01 Plus recommends Bluetooth for Mac and specifies macOS 10.15 or later. USB-A receivers need a suitable adapter or hub on USB-C-only laptops; charging cables are not established data connections. XK01 is Bluetooth-only and lists iOS and Android too.

items.q: Should I choose a vertical mouse or a trackball?
items.a: EM11 NL changes grip while retaining mouse movement, with under-7.5-inch hand guidance. EM01 NL stays stationary and uses thumb control, with a 0–20° hinge. It requires learning thumb movement and cleaning the ball/socket. We have no measured comfort or accuracy winner.

items.q: Are these US QWERTY keyboards or European layouts?
items.a: The selected EK01 Plus and XK01 listings and photographs are US QWERTY, without UK/DE/FR/ES/IT suffixes. Regional layouts have separate listings. Recheck the exact title, variant and key legends after searching from our storefront link; QWERTY alone does not identify every symbol key.

items.q: Does XK01 include a touchpad, backlight or travel case?
items.a: This is the ordinary number-pad XK01, not the separate TP touchpad or Plus backlit models. The checked package list names keyboard, USB-C recharge cable and guide, but no travel case. Confirm current bundles with the seller.

items.q: Will EC200 fit me, and who pays if I return it?
items.a: ProtoArc recommends 5'4"–6'0" and 90–220 lb, with a 220 lb maximum. Ask for numeric seat-height limits; these were not verified in the text. Change-of-mind return freight is buyer-paid with authorization and original packaging required. Exact chair freight, pickup and disassembly rules were not established.

The policy states two years from delivery for computer accessories and five years for complete chairs sold through the official US website. EC200's comparison table says structural warranty: confirm component coverage. Service is non-transferable. Separately bought replacement parts are final sale without the standard warranty.

items.q: Are these final prices or a guaranteed affiliate discount?
items.a: No. These are displayed USD store prices for named variants checked November 26, 2026. Stock, promotions, currency, shipping and taxes can change totals. ProtoArc controls checkout prices. Links with ref=bftbqwpp may earn us a commission; no discount or unchanged-price guarantee is made.
